threshold_controller_rule: available >= normal_threshold -> normal/A/normal_threshold; emergency_threshold <= available < normal_threshold -> emergency/B/emergency_threshold (select the already-provisioned B set, no re-distribution); available < emergency_threshold -> failure (recovery cannot happen). The controller only SELECTS an existing A/B share set; it never changes any Shamir polynomial degree. A and B are BOTH generated and pre-distributed during setup; Emergency does NOT retransmit B.
d2_v2_semantics: B=Shamir(10,6) is provisioned alongside A=Shamir(10,8) at setup (pre-distribution); Emergency reuses the stored B set, with B_distribution_bytes = 0 at runtime. Only the reconstruction threshold is chosen; no shares are re-sent during Emergency.
runtime_threshold_available_model: available_shares == available_clients == (participating clients - post-share dropout clients) per round; each online UAV contributes one logical share contribution.
dynamic_weight_definition: For each SSDF-passing client, cosine is measured against the locked clean-cohort anchor maintained by logical dual-server PoisonGuard; before the anchor exists, weights are uniform. Positive-cosine weights are normalized with lambda_i <= 2/|A_t| and clipped mass is redistributed. Final weights blend 25% anchor weights with 75% uniform weights; all-nonpositive scores fall back to uniform. New global = sum(lambda_i * local_i) = global + sum(lambda_i * delta_i). SSDF-removed / recovery-failed clients get lambda 0.
vl_verification_definition: Additive-group homomorphic accumulator H(v) = v . g (deterministic random vector g). Verifies H(weighted_agg_delta) == sum_i lambda_i H(delta_i) within tolerance; lightweight and non-cryptographic.
aggregation_update_def: delta_i = local_model_i - global_model (model-delta, NOT gradient); FedAvg/Krum/TrimmedMean all use the identical delta representation.
straggler_ratio_definition: straggler_ratio = max(client_compute_time) / mean(client_compute_time) measured per round over participating clients, using client_compute_time (real training + simulated CPU-bound workload). Describes compute completion-time imbalance only, NOT an FL performance metric.
dropout_model: simulated client unavailability via Flower Error reply
failure_note: In this stage no failure injection other than simulated client dropout is used, so actual_dropout_clients == failures. This relation is stage-specific and must NOT be assumed to hold for the full system later.
communication_definition: Communication overhead is measured over the TRAINING phase only: comm_payload_down = model_payload_bytes * participating_clients (global model broadcast to every training client); comm_payload_up = sum of the serialized ArrayRecord payloads of SUCCESSFUL client uploads (failed clients are excluded); comm_payload_total = down + up. The evaluation phase (model re-broadcast and scalar-metric responses) is excluded to avoid double-counting the same model payload. comm_bytes_wire is NOT available and is reported as 'unavailable'; it is never estimated.
round_time_definition: round_time = wall-clock from the start of this round's configure_train to the start of the next round's configure_train; for the last round it extends to the return of strategy.start(). round 0 (initial global evaluation only) is defined as 0. This is an instrumentation-defined duration, not a Flower-internal official round duration.
